sign_in_codes_target_check.name: sign_in_codes_target_check
sign_in_codes_target_check.value:
("sign_in_codes"."purpose" = 'sign_in' and "sign_in_codes"."email_hash" is not null and "sign_in_codes"."user_id" is null
                    and "sign_in_codes"."challenge_hash" is not null)
                or ("sign_in_codes"."purpose" = 'delete_account' and "sign_in_codes"."user_id" is not null
                    and "sign_in_codes"."email_hash" is null and "sign_in_codes"."challenge_hash" is null)

users_email_check.name: users_email_check
users_email_check.value:
"users"."email" = lower(btrim("users"."email")) and char_length("users"."email") between 3 and 254
                and char_length(split_part("users"."email", '@', 1)) <= 64
                and "users"."email" ~ '^[a-z0-9!#$%&*+/=?^_{|}~-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9!#$%&*+/=?^_{|}~-]+)*@(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])$'
